blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Marie June Adriano won another bronze for the Philippine national karate team in the Asian Games 2026 after beating Chinese Taipei’s Ya-chi Chung, 10-3, in the battle for third of the women’s kumite -50kg on Wednesday at Toyohashi Gymnasium. Adriano dominated the bronze medal game, securing the country’s fourth bronze medal in Aichi-Nagoya and second in karate, a day after Samantha Emmanuelle Veguillas, Ysabielle Arrogante and Rebecca Cyril Torres won bronze in the women’s kata team event.
